translations.translatedText: # Sunday 4.12.2016 (radio)
A man shot 3 women in Imatra. The shooting has shocked the people of Imatra. Cuba's former president Fidel Castro has been buried. Helping is healthy. There is snow and frost in Lapland.
## The Imatra shooting
![In front of the restaurant Vuoksenvahti in Imatra.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9333765)
Open image viewer
A man shot 3 women in front of the restaurant Vuoksenvahti. Photo: Yle
A serious crime has happened in the town of Imatra in eastern Finland. 3 women died when they were shot.
The crime happened in the centre of Imatra. The women were shot in front of the restaurant Vuoksenvahti at midnight.
The police say that the dead are Finnish women from Imatra. 1 of the women was a politician and 2 of the women were journalists.
The police suspect that the shooter is a 23-year-old man from Imatra. The police arrested him right after the incident.
The police do not yet know why the man shot the women. However, it looks like the act was not political. It did not matter to the man whom he shot.
The police say that the man has committed violent crimes before.
## The grief of the people of Imatra
![Candles burn at Imatrankoski in memory of those who died in the night.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9334053)
Open image viewer
The people of Imatra have brought candles to the place of the shooting. Photo: Tommi Parkkinen / Yle
The shooting has shocked the people of Imatra. Many have brought candles to the scene.
Crisis help has also been arranged for the people of Imatra. A crisis point was opened soon after the events of the night. At the crisis point, people have been able to get someone to talk to.
## Castro's funeral
![Fidel Castro's funeral procession on its way to the Santa Ifigenia cemetery in Santiago de Cuba.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9334116)
Open image viewer
Cuba's former leader Fidel Castro was buried on Sunday. Photo: Alejandro Ernesto / EPA
Cuba's former president Fidel Castro has been buried. The funeral was held on Sunday.
Fidel Castro died about a week ago. He was 90 years old. He was the leader of Cuba for almost 50 years.
Castro came to power in a revolution in 1959, and he made Cuba a socialist country.
Today, the president of Cuba is Fidel Castro's brother, Raul Castro. He promised at the funeral that the socialist principles of the revolution will continue in Cuba.
## Helping pays off
![Fabric with a heart and star pattern.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-8662543)
Open image viewer
The heart does well when a person gives or receives help. Photo: Kalevi Rytkölä / Yle
Helping is healthy.
When a person gives or receives help, the amount of the love hormone in the body increases. The love hormone, or oxytocin, affects, for example, the heart and breathing.
Docent Lotta Uusitalo-Malmivaara says that the perfect moment of love is the question "can I be of help". The person getting help feels safe, and the person giving help feels important.
It is often difficult for Finns to ask for or offer help. Luckily it is Christmas, docent Uusitalo-Malmivaara says. Then it is easier to do good and help others.
## Winter in Lapland
![kuttainen enontekiö winter polar night](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9332810)
Open image viewer
There is already snow and frost in Lapland. Photo: Minna Näkkäläjärvi / Yle
There is already a beautiful winter in northern Finland. Lapland has had plenty of snow and frost.
There is the most snow in Kittilä in Lapland. There is over 40 centimetres of snow there.
A new frost record for this winter was measured in Utsjoki in Lapland on the night between Saturday and Sunday. It was minus 34 degrees.
